verdict.rationale: Stripe documents payouts to your bank account, with payouts and expected deposit dates visible in the Dashboard. Report runs for balance, payouts and activity produce downloadable CSVs, and balance transactions are exposed via API/MCP. Refunds and disputes are separately viewable or manageable. The evidence never explicitly describes a payout-level reconciliation report that itemizes fees, refunds and chargebacks against each bank deposit, so reconciliation is only implied from these pieces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of payout reconciliation reports itemizing fees/refunds/chargebacks per settlement, matching of payouts to bank deposits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
